name: Whisper base
notes: ENCODER-DECODER. ENCODER: 6 layers, d_model 512, 8 heads, encoder_ffn_dim 2048, gelu, num_mel_bins 80, max_source_positions 1500. DECODER: 6 layers, 8 heads, decoder_ffn_dim 2048, max_target_positions 448. KV CACHE: decoder self-attention 6 * 8 * 64 * 2 * 2 = 40,960 B/token = 40 KiB/token. Cross-attention over 1500 encoder frames: 6 * 8 * 64 * 1500 * 2 * 2 = 18,432,000 B = 17.6 MiB per in-flight request. STREAMING: not natively supported (offline/batch model).
